_read_me: One metric per file. Copy to metrics/<id>.json (e.g. metrics/on-time-acknowledgement.json). Write the definition so a stranger would count exactly what you count. scor_attribute: reliability, responsiveness, agility, cost or assets.
name: Orders acknowledged within 30 minutes
definition: An order counts as on time if our acknowledgement reaches the repo within 30 minutes of the order. Orders sent outside class hours start the clock at 9:55 the next class day.
calculation: orders acknowledged within 30 minutes / orders received, this week
data_needed: signals: sent_at of the order and of our acknowledgement that responds_to it
